record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the integration check through the real entry point, then every other phase check.

## Approach

Run the integration test that pipes wizard input through `python -m orchestra` and asserts only the selected host is written. Then run the focused detection, empty-detection, plan and decline, list, scope, interactive, non-interactive, explicit-flag, dry-run, and README checks. Record a check-run for each acceptance; do not mark the phase done until all pass. Landing is completed at phase close.

payload.title: Verify the installer wizard and detection
